latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Add Music to Video Canva — Add Music and Export Videos".

- Add background music to video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB).
- Fast, cloud-based processing (20–40 seconds per export, 1080p MP4 output).
- Automated setup: acquires and manages session/token for each user.
- Simple chat interface—just upload video or ask for music integration.
- Supports balance checking, export/download, session state, and format restrictions.
- Robust error handling and clear workflow guidance (credits, rate limit, file limits, etc.).
